comment: 🔴 65.2 — the high-water mark for rendered prose, in WORDS A PERSON HAS TO READ, per portal. `npm run prose` FAILS when one rises. Lowering it is the work; raising it is a decision somebody makes on purpose, in a diff, with a reason in PLAN.md. A wall split into four keys is the same wall, which is why the unit is a word rather than a key. `origin` is where sprint 65 started and NOTHING writes to it: the accept line asks for half off every portal and 80% off the public site, and a baseline that follows the work downward cannot answer that. The first numbers here attributed `home.*` to the public site and `radar.*` to it as well; both were corrected by grepping the call sites, which moved 221 words into the patient app and 201 into shared. The public figure fell from 5836 to 5460 for that reason alone, and no prose was removed by it. A second correction moved `pted.*` and `pracc.*` (220 words) from the patient app to the clinician's: both render on `app/(app)/patients/[id]/page.tsx`, and they are named for what they are ABOUT rather than who reads them. A third correction moved `cassess.*` (71 words) to the clinician's: it renders in `components/assessments/clinician-assessments.tsx`.
